## 🛂 Immigration
- ✅ OFFICIAL RULE / CHANGE **US Labor Department Escalates H-1B Compliance Audits**
  - *Agency:* US Department of Labor (DOL).
  - *Details:* Labor officials warned that compliance checks are expanding to target wage underpayment and inaccurate job duty reporting in H-1B filings [[The Economic Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5). No legal status rules were changed, but employer enforcement has intensified.
- 🟡 DEVELOPING **Canada Locks Study Permit Target at 1.5 Lakh Through 2029**

## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts
- 🔴 **ACTION NEEDED** — **Fake Electricity Bill & Digital Arrest Frauds**
  - *How the scam works:* Cybercriminals send fake SMS messages warning of immediate power disconnection due to pending KYC updates, or call victims pretending to be law enforcement placing them under "digital arrest" for money laundering [[India]](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/video/elderly-woman-defrauded-of-71-lakh-in-delhi-digital-arrest-cyber-scam-ytvd-3039403-2026-11-15?utm_source=rss) [[Livemint]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5). An elderly Delhi resident lost ₹71 lakh to a digital arrest scam.
  - *What to do:* Never click links in unexpected text messages. Police agencies and utility providers **never** demand money transfers via phone or video calls. Hang up immediately and verify calls using official contact details.

## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **401(k) Contribution Limits & Indexing:** A 401(k) is an employer-sponsored retirement savings account in the US that allows employees to invest pre-tax income directly from their paychecks. To prevent inflation from eroding retirement purchasing power, the IRS periodically raises the maximum annual contribution limit. For 2027, the limit increases by $1,000 to **$25,500** [[Fox Business]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1hcEQzUVZ2TDN2dGN2Q2lJRWFZU0RSQ1FLZV9Qa0gxMWMxTkZHMGRuUTlhb3BuZWhIaGVpUm91TmpVSm5qU1hma2VqMTNfQ2RUSThQLXFJMFczZDg?oc=5) [[Pluang]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNbkd5NkFvSnNsbldYVm5aRFpxRGMtM2JHUWlkSUh6c3h5UmN3cWxrM3NmR0RFSmwwZmRhN0x2RGJYd25VNEc2c21ZTkR6b2JVVHRYdWxYcXd4cGtWMXk1ak5LM0szLS1fUmZGY1VDMmN1cmdicUNGV2NEMWhtLS14NHM4ZFY0Z2VWVlhpaWV3YUtGalV2Y3BqOTI0VzlSRVMzbUNmY0FwNzk?oc=5).
